description: Robustness check on the cross-atom binding-overshoot trend (#2635). Confirms the overshoot O(K)=A(K)*tr_M/(−B/m_e) is EXACT given canonical inputs (A(K) factors are exact q-integers + Vol_hyp), correcting the earlier '≤2.5% value-band' framing (the 2.5% is Phase-4 modeling accuracy A(K)≈|Delta_lambda*|, not value-uncertainty). Tests trend robustness under per-atom and exponent-amplified per-factor modeling error, and Vol_hyp/knot-ID sensitivity. No fit; no P_lambda.
framing_correction: A(K)=Vol_hyp/[8]_q·[3]_q^{2(Z-1)}·(q^{1/2}+q^{-1/2})^{4N} has EXACT factors at q0; overshoot is exact. The <=2.5% is Phase-4 modeling accuracy (A(K)≈|Delta_lambda*|), NOT a value-uncertainty band (corrects #2631/#2635).
